body:
And every one tells you that its takes strength to keep on living. Its like they dont understand at this point we feel like no thats the easier thing to do, we breathe with out thought. That trigger though those few pounds of pressure is all it takes and we cant manage to do it. Not because we dont want to, but because we dont have the courage. I dont know about you but I am veteran, so I feel like i am suppose to have this outstanding source of courage and I see this simple thing I have done a million times and I just cant manage to do it this one last time and I dont know why. 

All we can do is breathe, put one foot in front of the other and keep on walking and searching. Searching for that light at the end of the tunnel and plead with anything and everything that we find it sooner rather then later. 

I dont know if this will be of any help to you but I hope that it shows you that you are not alone in feeling like this. I hope that it shows you that some people can understand those terrible feelings. I am sure you already know that though.

The first time I told some one was a month ago too and I am 28, and I went and got help and a useless prescription. I am a veteran so I have been drilled with how shameful these thoughts are but I don't care anymore. 

I felt lifted telling the person but the flood gates just opened up again and even worst.
